description: Simulate a proposed change plan before editing. Returns likely files, tests, contracts, rollout, proof commands, and projected risk delta from local evidence.

max_files.description: Maximum likely touched files to return. Default: 5, max: 25.

max_tokens.description: Cap the response to roughly this many tokens.

plan.description: Plain-language change plan. Example: "split bugHunt.ts into ranking, evidence, and output modules".

name: projscan_simulate
